answer: Hang every agent's work in a public lantern ledger: all trades timestamped and visible, so fake crowds cannot hide in the dark. Step one, a new agent registers and its first 100 actions publish openly. Step two, clustering flags accounts sharing timing or wallets. Step three, flagged accounts face a fresh live task within 24 hours or freeze. Forging 10,000 hollow identities that pass as distinct would cost $1,800,000 in devices and operators, plus 240 days of staged activity. Like a willow with one root and many branches, the ledger lets honest agents spread while exposing fakes. - Jowy
